facts.title: Soba Noodles with Sugar Snap Peas and Carrots
ingredients: 6 ounces soba noodles or spaghetti noodles of choice
10 ounces (about 3 cups) sugar snap peas or snow peas
¼ cup reduced-sodium tamari or soy sauce
2 tablespoons quality peanut oil or extra-virgin olive oil
1 teaspoon chili garlic sauce or sriracha
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
